capabilities: Create cloze cards with highlight syntax and Q&A cards with question-mark syntax
Review due cards with Again/Hard/Good ratings and instant requeueing
Schedule card intervals automatically based on ratings
Hide headings from the review path with an HTML comment marker
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Review progress is stored as HTML comments above each card, so data stays in the user's notes with no external service.
intentEvidence: Inspired by Anki and Obsidian Spaced Repetition plugin
problem: Obsidian has no built-in flashcard review, and existing spaced repetition plugins require setup before you can start reviewing.
